propositions: Canonical preview must execute one ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit a single manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift detail from that same pass, without invoking or reimplementing reconcile-check.

Canonical preview must load a lock-free read-only snapshot and produce its manifest without acquiring, purging, stealing, or writing the pass lock; collateral repository and ref state must remain unchanged.

The argparse parser must set allow_abbrev=False to make undocumented prefix abbreviations (e.g., --dry-run for --dry-run-enumerate) fail with invocation error 2 before any reads, locks, or mutations, while documented options like --mode dry-run remain valid.
Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit identical field-comparable manifest envelopes; canonical uncapped live must retain a manifest with exact applied/failed tally.
Legacy reconcile-check, uncapped LIVE output, and all existing compatibility modes (library, MCP, older workflows) must retain their historical observable behavior unchanged.
Canonical preview must read the active local-ticket set exactly once and not launch a separate reconcile-check or duplicate-comparison pass.
